description.subtitle: Camiseta de calentamiento prepartido Hummel del Real Betis Balompié 2026 2027 - verde
description.tagline: Prepárate para el partido como el Betis
description.intro: The Hummel Betis Pre-Match t-shirt is the official warm-up garment of Real Betis Balompié for the 2026-2027 season. Its striking graphic design in green tones reflects the personality of the club and accompanies the players during the exercises prior to the start of the match.
key_benefits: Official Real Betis design: Pre-match warm-up shirt for the 2026 2027 season.
Exclusive graphic: Print inspired by the green and white identity that provides a dynamic and modern style.
Lightweight, breathable fabric: Promotes ventilation to maintain comfort during warm-up.
Maximum freedom of movement: Sporty cut designed to perform in total comfort before the game.
